title: Galax-z v13
description: Galax-z v12 with the GROOVE page light green.
notes: GROOVE, a seventh page on tracks 1-8, light green after the teal one: keys are kept and played by one of 69 grooves; on a melodic track one of 133 progressions takes them through its chords. Hold SHIFT two seconds for its other four dials.
Two Quindar tones when the OP-Z is switched on, in place of TE's start sound. disable_start_sound in general.json turns them off; Galax-z v13 quiet has none.
The Galax-z app is told where the tumbler's balls, EUCLID's rings and GROOVE's notes are, and shows them on FX and TRACK. Only while it is connected.
Everything of v9: the tumbler, EUCLID, older USB keyboards, pedal and wheel, presets that stay, the load meter, more live voices, A/B bars, boot animations, the debounce.
